sources.entry: TrackWatch ⚠ - Automated music release tracker for Spotify with email notifications, discography generator, and ghost track cleaner (alternative to Release Radar). (Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: TrackWatch is a self-hosted web app that tracks new releases from artists you follow on Spotify and adds them to a dedicated playlist.
summary.what_it_does: It connects to a user's Spotify account via OAuth and lets them follow artists whose new releases are tracked automatically. New releases are added to a dedicated TrackWatch playlist. It includes ghost track detection to find and remove unavailable tracks from playlists. Checks run on a schedule (README says 3x daily at 7am, 2pm, 9pm by default, configurable via environment variables), or can be triggered externally by webhook. The README also mentions email notifications via Resend and a discography generator, though the discography feature is only named in the awesome-selfhosted listing and not described in the README. The stack is a multi-container Docker Compose setup: Nginx frontend, Django/Gunicorn backend, optional APScheduler worker, and PostgreSQL.
use_cases: track new releases from favorite artists on Spotify
automatically fill a Spotify playlist with new music
find and remove unavailable tracks from Spotify playlists
schedule periodic checks for new album drops
receive email notifications about new releases
how_to_run: Edit .env with SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_PASSWORD, SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
Optional: docker-compose --profile scheduler up -d --build to run the internal scheduler
notable: Spotify OAuth integration with an automatically maintained TrackWatch playlist
Ghost track detection removes unavailable tracks from playlists
Scheduler is optional; external triggers via authenticated webhook (n8n or cron) are supported
Multi-container architecture with separate frontend, backend, scheduler, and database services
Prebuilt images published to GitHub Container Registry
caveats: Spotify redirect URIs require HTTPS except for 127.0.0.1; localhost is not accepted and LAN IPs or custom domains need HTTPS
Requires creating your own Spotify Developer app with a Client ID and Secret
Email notifications require a Resend API key (optional)
The legacy all-in-one Docker image is still documented but the multi-container setup is the active model
